products.name: WSUS to Windows Update for Business Patch Modernization — Commercial
products.short_description: A clean migration off WSUS to Windows Update for Business, managed from Intune — update rings, deferrals, deadlines, and Delivery Optimization — so devices patch from Microsoft anywhere and the WSUS servers retire. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Retire WSUS — move Windows patching to Windows Update for Business, managed from Intune

WSUS is a maintenance tax: a server to patch and back up, a content store that bloats and corrupts, declined-update cleanup, and approvals that only reach devices on the corporate network. Remote machines simply fall behind. This solution gives you a clean migration off WSUS to Windows Update for Business, managed through Intune: update rings, feature/quality deferrals, deadlines, and Delivery Optimization — so devices patch from Microsoft wherever they are, and you can decommission the WSUS servers.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — why WSUS is a liability, how Windows Update for Business and Intune update rings replace it, feature/quality update deferrals and deadlines, Delivery Optimization, and the coexistence-then-cutover plan to retire WSUS.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra-joined or hybrid devices, removing conflicting WSUS/GPO update policy, internet/Delivery Optimization reachability, ring design) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory current WSUS approvals and update policy, design rings, create Windows Update for Business ring policies in Intune, remove conflicting WSUS/GPO settings, validate devices scan against Microsoft, decommission WSUS, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — update-configuration discovery (detect WSUS/GPO conflicts), patch-compliance validation, a fleet patch-status and ring report, safe remediation (clear WSUS pointers), and an update-ring group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Windows patching modernized off WSUS — devices updating from Microsoft via Intune update rings wherever they are, conflicts removed, and the WSUS servers decommissioned — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WSUSM-Discovery.ps1 — detect the WSUS server pointer and conflicting GPO/registry update policy
    • WSUSM-Remediation.ps1 — clear residual WSUS pointers / conflicting update policy (safe by default)
    • WSUSM-Report.ps1 — fleet patch-status and update-ring report (Microsoft Graph)
    • WSUSM-Set-UpdateRingTargeting.ps1 — build the update-ring device groups (Microsoft Graph)
    • WSUSM-Validation.ps1 — confirm this device scans Microsoft/WUfB, not WSUS

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
